In this visit it is not directly tied to the dermatitis plan, so the immediate harm risk is limited but still clinically relevant history.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes steroid cream but does not specify twice daily/BD dosing.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document twice-daily (BD) dosing for a prescribed topical steroid can lead to unclear instructions, potential under-treatment (persistent symptoms) or overuse (skin atrophy/irritation), depending on what is assumed. In practice the pharmacy label/prescription often carries the dosing, so the harm is usually limited to communication/continuity issues.
